seo.seo_title: Sanjari Computers | Trivo Portfolio Case Study
seo.seo_description: Building a stronger online presence for an e-waste recycling and IT asset disposal company.

sections.title: Sanjari Computers
sections.body: Building a stronger online presence for an e-waste recycling and IT asset disposal company.

sections.title: About Sanjari Computers
sections.body: Sanjari Computers focuses on e-waste recycling, IT asset disposal, computer scrap buying, and secure data destruction. The company provides solutions for businesses looking to dispose of old IT equipment and electronic waste responsibly.

sections.title: Tracking Organic Search Performance
sections.body:
Google Search Console and website analytics data were used to monitor organic search performance, impressions, clicks and search visibility.

These reports help evaluate SEO progress and identify opportunities for further website optimization.

sections.title: SEO Results & Growth
sections.body: The SEO work focused on building a stronger organic presence through website content, targeted landing pages, blog optimization and on-page SEO improvements.

sections.title: Google Ads Campaign Management
sections.body: Google Ads campaigns were focused on reaching potential customers actively searching for e-waste recycling, computer scrap buying and IT disposal services. Campaign strategy included keyword targeting, ad copy creation, campaign optimization and performance monitoring to improve relevant traffic and generate business enquiries.

sections.title: Social Media Marketing – LinkedIn
sections.body:
LinkedIn

LinkedIn marketing built professional brand awareness, showcased e-waste management services, shared industry insights, and strengthened the company's presence among businesses — highlighting sustainability initiatives and building credibility with a relevant professional audience.

sections.title: Website Traffic & Traffic Acquisition
sections.body:
Website traffic and acquisition data was monitored to understand how users discovered Sanjari Computers online, which channels brought visitors and how traffic sources contributed to overall digital performance.

The analysis focused on organic search, paid traffic, direct visits and other traffic sources to evaluate marketing performance and identify opportunities for further growth.
